<thought>Identify a template for the Doebner modification (aldehyde + malonic acid → α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid). The forward reaction breaks an aldehyde and a carboxylic acid and forms a C‑C double bond.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
